Thus, the name Efaz is a constant reminder of the importance of being grateful and humble, and it inspires the bearer to strive towards living a life that is pleasing to Allah. In summary, the name Efaz signifies the belief in Allah's mercy and blessings and inspires the bearer to live a grateful and charitable life.
